body.statement: The constant witness satisfies \((P_{\mathrm{const},-}+P_{\mathrm{const},+})/2=Q_{\mathrm{const}}\) on the observed one-record experiment, although the two component laws have target zero and \(Q_{\mathrm{const}}\) has target \(4ab\). The signed family also satisfies \(2^{-k}\sum_\lambda P_{+,\lambda}=2^{-k}\sum_\lambda P_{-,\lambda}\) on one observed record. Consequently, the relevant target fibers have intersecting one-record convex hulls, and every bounded additive one-record score has zero prior-averaged expectation margin for the signed pair of fibers.
body.justification: This establishes on legal unknown-propensity CATE laws that the missing signal is genuinely higher order.
body.gap: Canonne et al. characterize private tests for two simple product hypotheses using clamped one-record likelihood increments; their Section 3 construction does not apply when composite target fibers have intersecting one-record convex hulls.
body.consumer: It rules out reverting to a randomized-treatment or additive one-record score for the full-fiber lift.
